proposals.title: Shareholder Proxy Access Amendments
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend the proxy access bylaw so shareholder nominees equal 20% of directors or 2, whichever is greater, increasing potential nominees.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 4.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal to Improve Executive Compensation Program
proposals.topic_summary: Asks Apple to improve the executive compensation program to include NEOs pay ratios and other ethical, social and economic factors in pay design.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 5.
